description: OPFLearnData: Dataset for Learning AC Optimal Power Flow is a data set deposited in DOE National Library of the Rockies (NLR) Repository by its authors Trager Joswig-Jones, Ahmed Zamzam (University of Washington). The datasets are resulting from OPFLearn.jl, a Julia package for creating AC OPF datasets. The package was developed to provide researchers with a standardized way to efficiently create AC OPF datasets that are representative of more of the AC OPF feasible load space compared to typical dataset creation methods. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2021. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 12 files. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
